card.name: The word Grade in adverse event severity
card.fires_on: The word "Grade" (or the number or space right after it) when a severity grade is being given for an adverse reaction, mostly in cancer immunotherapy labels. It usually follows "including" or "of" and comes before a number such as 3 or 4.

modes.description: The word Grade after "including" in a list of severity grades with percentages.
